messages.subject: an 'non-ASCII chars' issue
parts:
Hello,


I saw two warning messages and one error while I practice cfa() with
non-ASCII variable names(here, Korean). The error message says, " 소비자
태도 =~ Error in substr(name, 1, 13) : invalid multibyte string at
'<eb>'". But, the variable names with Non-Ascii characters work well in
the R base system. Is it lavaan's internal issue? Please see the
messages below:

Thank you in advance.


Jong-Hwa


=======================================
example1)

Latent variables:
Warning in abbreviate(NAMES, minlength = 13, strict = TRUE) :
abbreviate used with non-ASCII chars
구매의도 =~
구매의도1 1.000
구매의도2 1.062 0.050 21.164 0.000
구매의도3 1.076 0.059 18.386 0.000

Variances:
Warning in abbreviate(NAMES, minlength = 13, strict = TRUE) :
abbreviate used with non-ASCII chars
구매의도1 0.395 0.059
구매의도2 0.237 0.055
구매의도3 0.633 0.081
구매의도 1.719 0.208
=======================================
example2)

Latent variables:
Warning in abbreviate(NAMES, minlength = 13, strict = TRUE) :
abbreviate used with non-ASCII chars
소비자태도 =~
Error in substr(name, 1, 13) : invalid multibyte string at '<eb>'

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: an 'non-ASCII chars' issue
parts:
On 10/08/2012 04:43 AM, SHIN Jong-Hwa wrote:
> Hello,
>
>
> I saw two warning messages and one error while I practice cfa() with
> non-ASCII variable names(here, Korean). The error message says, " 소비자
> 태도 =~ Error in substr(name, 1, 13) : invalid multibyte string at
> '<eb>'". But, the variable names with Non-Ascii characters work well in
> the R base system. Is it lavaan's internal issue?

This is an internal lavaan issue. The model syntax gets parsed, and some
of the commands [eg. substr()] need special care to deal with mutli-byte
strings. We need to work on that.

Could you send my (off-list) some text files containing model syntax
with mutli-byte (korean) characters? We will use these for testing.

Yves.
